## Contribution rules for fluxcd/flux2

- For non-trivial changes, open or find an issue and agree on the approach first. (https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md#L86)
- Disclose AI assistance in the PR description. (https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md#L42)
- Add an `Assisted-by: <agent>/<model>` trailer to every commit. (https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md#L42)
- Do NOT list an AI tool as co-author (no `Co-authored-by: <AI>` lines). (https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md#L39)
- A human must write replies to review comments; do not generate or post them. (https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md#L36)
- Sign off every commit (`git commit -s`) with the human's name and email, never the agent's. (https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md#L39)
- Run the tests locally before opening or updating the PR. (https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/blob/HEAD/AGENTS.md#L21)
